# sprites/ — optional local drop-ins (never commit real rips)

Shipped placeholders (`imp/demon/baron/shotgun.png`, generated by
`make_placeholders.py`, ours/CC0) keep the loader 404-free and prove the
pipeline. Overwrite them with your own art for local testing:

`game.js:loadCustomSprites()` auto-uses `imp.png`, `demon.png`, `baron.png`
(enemy walk-frame variants) when present.
